info.title: ClaudeForge Banking Suite API
info.description:
Horizon Bank retail banking platform (business case BC-AINE-001).

Conventions:
- Every money field is a decimal STRING matching ^-?\d{1,16}(\.\d{1,2})?$, never a JSON number (NFR-01, DD-05, DD-16).
- Every 4xx and 5xx response uses the uniform ErrorEnvelope (DD-10) without exception.
- Paginated collections use ?page=&size= and return {items, page, page_size, total, total_pages} (DD-11).
- X-Correlation-ID is accepted on request and echoed on every response (DD-18).
- No rate limiting exists: no acceptance criterion requires it and none is implemented.
- Deliberately absent: transfer caps, daily limits and velocity controls; any requirement that a transfer destination be a saved beneficiary; any applicant age or date-of-birth gate; any loan eligibility computation. Loan approval is an administrator decision (AC-08).

post.summary: Atomic transfer to any valid active account
post.description: AC-04, AC-05. The destination is a plain account number supplied directly; there is no beneficiary_id field and no beneficiary is required (DD-13). The whole operation is one transaction: lock source, re-read balance, evaluate policy, debit, credit, two transaction rows, audit entry, notification enqueue, commit. Any failure rolls everything back and moves zero money. There is no transfer cap, daily limit or velocity control (DD-14.1).

bearerAuth.description: HS256 JWT carrying sub (customer id), role, iat and exp. Lifetime is settings.jwt_expiry_minutes, default 30. Stateless; no refresh token. Enforced at the API layer by require_principal; admin routes additionally require require_admin (NFR-04).

XCorrelationId.description: Correlation id for this request, echoed on every response including errors (DD-18).

Page.name: page
Page.description: 1-based page number. An out-of-range page returns 200 with an empty items array.

Size.name: size
Size.description: Page size, default 20 from settings.statement_page_size, maximum 100 (DD-11). Note the response field is named page_size.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-ID
CorrelationId.description: Optional. If absent the middleware generates a UUID4 (DD-18).

field.description: Name of the offending request field.

message.example: Must have at most 2 decimal places.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error identifier (DD-10). Never localised.

message.description: Human-readable message safe to display. Contains no PII, token, password or document number.
message.example: Transfer declined: available balance is lower than the requested amount.

field_errors.description: Present only for input-validation failures; null otherwise.

correlation_id.description: Identical to the X-Correlation-ID response header (DD-18).

ErrorEnvelope.description: Uniform error envelope used by every 4xx and 5xx response without exception (DD-10).

PageMeta.description: Pagination metadata (DD-11). Query parameter is 'size'; response field is 'page_size'.

database.description: Result of a real SELECT 1 round-trip (NFR-07).

password.description: Never logged, never returned, stored only as a KDF hash.

date_of_birth.description: Profile data only. No rule reads it: there is no minimum applicant age and no date-of-birth eligibility gate (DD-14.3).

role.description: Always CUSTOMER for a registered account; ADMIN is seeded only.

password.description: Proves control of the account before activation.

document_type.description: Recognised document types. Anything else is a 422.

document_number.description: Redacted in every log line (NFR-03). The reserved synthetic value X0000000 always yields REJECTED (A-02).

customer_status.description: Customer status after the verdict was applied.

password.description: Plaintext in transit only; never logged.

access_token.description: HS256 JWT carrying sub, role, iat and exp.

role.description: Role carried by the issued token.

OpenAccountRequest.description: All fields optional. An empty object opens a SAVINGS account at 0.00.

balance.description: Current balance. Initialises to 0.00 on opening (AC-02); there is no minimum balance. Decimal string on the wire, never a JSON number (NFR-01, DD-05, DD-16).

counterparty_account_id.description: Other side of the movement; null for a loan disbursement credit.

amount.description: Absolute movement amount. Decimal string on the wire, never a JSON number (NFR-01, DD-05, DD-16).

balance_after.description: Resulting balance of account_id after this row was applied. Decimal string on the wire, never a JSON number (NFR-01, DD-05, DD-16).

transfer_id.description: Shared by the DEBIT and CREDIT rows of one transfer; null for a disbursement.

PageOfTransaction.description: Paginated envelope of Transaction, ordered most-recent-first (DD-11, A-06).

nickname.description: The customer's own label for this payee.

beneficiary_name.description: Payee's name as the customer records it.

beneficiary_account_number.description: Must resolve to an existing account.

Beneficiary.description: A saved payee. A convenience feature only: a beneficiary is never a precondition of a transfer (AC-06, DD-13).

CreateTransferRequest.description: Destination is supplied as a plain account number. There is no beneficiary_id field: a saved beneficiary is not required, not referenced and not checked (DD-13, AC-04). There is no transfer cap, daily limit or velocity control (DD-14.1).

source_account_id.description: Must be owned by the caller and ACTIVE.

destination_account_number.description: Any existing ACTIVE account. No beneficiary relationship is required.

amount.description: Strictly positive, at most 2 decimal places. No upper bound. Decimal string on the wire, never a JSON number (NFR-01, DD-05, DD-16).

id.description: Transfer identifier; also the transfer_id on both transaction rows.

destination_account_id.description: Credited account; null if the destination could not be resolved.

amount.description: Amount moved. Decimal string on the wire, never a JSON number (NFR-01, DD-05, DD-16).

status.description: Outcome. A FAILED attempt moved no money (A-08).

failure_code.description: Populated on FAILED only; matches the error.code returned to the caller.

description.description: Free text supplied by the caller.

source_balance_after.description: Source balance after a COMPLETED transfer; null on FAILED. Decimal string on the wire, never a JSON number (NFR-01, DD-05, DD-16).

PageOfTransfer.description: Paginated envelope of Transfer, ordered most-recent-first (DD-11, A-06).

CreateLoanRequest.description: Structural validation only. There is no eligibility computation: no principal bound, no tenure bound, no income requirement, no instalment-to-income ratio, no credit score and no risk band (DD-14.4). Approval is an administrator decision (AC-08).

principal.description: Strictly positive, at most 2 decimal places. No minimum and no maximum. Decimal string on the wire, never a JSON number (NFR-01, DD-05, DD-16).

tenure_months.description: A positive whole number of months. No maximum.

purpose.description: Free text. Read by no rule.

declared_monthly_income.description: Optional and informational. No rule consumes this value. Decimal string on the wire, never a JSON number (NFR-01, DD-05, DD-16).

disbursement_account_id.description: An ACTIVE SAVINGS account owned by the applicant.

principal.description: Requested principal. Decimal string on the wire, never a JSON number (NFR-01, DD-05, DD-16).

declared_monthly_income.description: Optional and informational; no rule reads it. Decimal string on the wire, never a JSON number (NFR-01, DD-05, DD-16).

from_status.description: Null for the initial APPLIED row.

actor_id.description: Customer for APPLIED; administrator for every later transition.

reason.description: Mandatory and non-empty on APPROVED and REJECTED (AC-08); optional otherwise.

principal.description: Requested principal. Decimal string on the wire, never a JSON number (NFR-01, DD-05, DD-16).

declared_monthly_income.description: Optional and informational; no rule reads it. Decimal string on the wire, never a JSON number (NFR-01, DD-05, DD-16).

principal.description: Requested principal. Decimal string on the wire, never a JSON number (NFR-01, DD-05, DD-16).

declared_monthly_income.description: Optional and informational; no rule reads it. Decimal string on the wire, never a JSON number (NFR-01, DD-05, DD-16).

applicant_name.description: Applicant's full name, denormalised for the queue.

PageOfAdminLoan.description: Paginated envelope of AdminLoanSummary, ordered most-recent-first (DD-11, A-06).

ReviewRequest.description: A reason is optional here; it is mandatory only on approve and reject (AC-08).

DecisionRequest.description: A non-empty reason is mandatory. An administrator cannot approve or reject silently (AC-08, E-13).

reason.description: 1-500 characters after trimming. Empty or whitespace-only is a 422.

disbursement_account_id.description: Overrides the account on the application. Must be an ACTIVE SAVINGS account owned by the applicant.

note.example: Disbursed to the applicant's savings account.

example.note: Disbursed to the applicant's savings account.

AuditEntry.description: Append-only ledger row (NFR-02). No update or delete path exists at any layer.

actor_id.description: Acting principal; null for a system-originated entry.

correlation_id.description: Join key back into the log stream (DD-18).

metadata.description: Opaque caller-supplied context. Never used as a WHERE predicate (DD-15).

PageOfAuditEntry.description: Paginated envelope of AuditEntry, ordered most-recent-first (DD-11, A-06).

channel.description: Stub channel; one dispatcher serves both (A-09).

event_type.description: Business event that produced this notification.

created_at.description: Enqueue timestamp; written inside the business transaction.

sent_at.description: Dispatch timestamp; null while QUEUED or FAILED.

PageOfNotification.description: Paginated envelope of Notification, ordered most-recent-first (DD-11, A-06).
